out_of_scope.what: DDD extraction assets (ingestion/DDD/*), upstream of dbt; the translator maps the dbt sources onto their keys
Rfam extraction assets (ingestion/RFAM/*), upstream of dbt
barrier_all_silver_exported and barrier_all_gold_exported: depend on export assets, not on dbt assets
danish_parliament_*_job and rfam_*_job (ingestion groups), export_silver_job and export_gold_job (export assets), bronze_archive_job and ducklake_cleanup_job: none runs dbt

links.reason: Bare 'bronze' is dbt's fqn method, which also matches the fqn without the package name: every model in models/bronze.

links.name: dbt_gold_assets
links.reason: fqn 'gold': every model in models/gold. The body also runs a context-less 'dbt run --select bronze_dates' before the build and passes --exclude data_engineering to the build; neither changes the definition's select.

links.api: custom @multi_asset built by _dbt_multi_asset (dagster_dbt build_dbt_specs with the given select)
links.name: dbt_data_engineering_assets
links.reason: fqn 'data_engineering': every model in models/data_engineering. extra_deps adds a dependency on export/barrier_all_gold_exported, not a dbt node.

links.name: dbt_seeds_job
links.reason: _seeds_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_seeds_assets]) with the default dbt_select: all of dbt_seeds_assets, the two seeds.

links.name: dbt_bronze_job
links.reason: _bronze_selection() is _bronze_ddd_selection() | _bronze_rfam_selection(), each build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_bronze_assets], dbt_select=' '.join(<list>)). The model names come from ddd_python/ddd_utils/configuration_variables.py: bronze_ddd_<name> for the 18 DANISH_DEMOCRACY_FILE_NAMES passed through normalize_danish_name (lower case, ø->oe, æ->ae, å->aa), and bronze_rfam_<table> for the 7 RFAM_TABLE_NAMES. build_dbt_asset_selection intersects them with dbt_bronze_assets' select. bronze_dates, bronze_dates_holidays and bronze_source_systems are not in the lists.

links.name: dbt_bronze_ddd_job
links.reason: _bronze_ddd_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_bronze_assets], dbt_select=' '.join(configuration_variables.DANISH_DEMOCRACY_MODELS_BRONZE)): the 18 bronze_ddd_* names derived in ddd_python/ddd_utils/configuration_variables.py (normalize_danish_name: lower case, ø->oe, æ->ae, å->aa).

links.name: dbt_bronze_rfam_job
links.reason: _bronze_rfam_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_bronze_assets], dbt_select=' '.join(configuration_variables.RFAM_MODELS_BRONZE)): the 7 bronze_rfam_* names derived in ddd_python/ddd_utils/configuration_variables.py.

links.name: dbt_silver_job
links.reason: _silver_selection() is _silver_ddd_selection() | _silver_rfam_selection(), each build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_silver_assets], dbt_select=_dbt_select_with_cv(<list>)): the silver_ddd_* and silver_rfam_* names (bronze_ replaced by silver_) and each name with _cv, which is all 50 Silver models.

links.name: dbt_silver_ddd_job
links.reason: _silver_ddd_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_silver_assets], dbt_select=_dbt_select_with_cv(configuration_variables.DANISH_DEMOCRACY_MODELS_SILVER)): the 18 silver_ddd_* names and their _cv views.

links.name: dbt_silver_rfam_job
links.reason: _silver_rfam_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_silver_assets], dbt_select=_dbt_select_with_cv(configuration_variables.RFAM_MODELS_SILVER)): the 7 silver_rfam_* names and their _cv views.

links.name: dbt_gold_job
links.reason: _gold_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_gold_assets]): every model in models/gold.

links.name: dbt_data_engineering_job
links.reason: _data_engineering_selection() is build_dbt_asset_selection([dbt_data_engineering_assets]): every model in models/data_engineering.

links.name: full_pipeline_job
links.reason: _full_pipeline_selection() is AssetSelection.groups(the four ingestion groups) | _bronze_selection() | _silver_selection() | _gold_selection() | AssetSelection.groups('export_silver', 'export_gold') | _data_engineering_selection(): the bronze (25), silver (50), gold (19) and data_engineering (9) models; the ingestion and export groups hold no dbt nodes. No seeds.
